I have completed the implementation and verification of Work Order 2 (Dossier Schema & Renderer) in [`internal/core/dossiers`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/dossiers):

### Summary of Completed Work

1. **Entry Schema & Types** ([`entry.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/dossiers/entry.go)):
   - Defined `EntryType` enum across all 8 types: `invariant`, `ruled-out`, `failure-signature`, `gotcha`, `decision`, `procedure`, `interface`, `open-issue`.
   - Defined `EntryTypePrefixes` map (`inv-`, `rul-`, `fail-`, `got-`, `dec-`, `proc-`, `iface-`, `issue-`).
   - Defined `Entry` struct with all fields (`ID`, `Type`, `DossierScope`, `Text`, `Anchors`, `Evidence`, `Verified`, `ClosesWhen`, `Source`, `CreatedAt`, `UpdatedAt`, `Retired`, `RetiredReason`, `SupersededBy`).

2. **Dossier Kinds & Atlas Schema** ([`dossier.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/dossiers/dossier.go)):
   - Defined `DossierKind` enum (`module`, `topic`, `external`, `procedure`).
   - Defined `Dossier` struct with `Scope`, `Kind`, `Title`, `Purpose`, active `Entries`, and `History`.
   - Defined `Atlas` and `AtlasEntry` structs.

3. **Op Log Projector** ([`projector.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/dossiers/projector.go)):
   - Implemented `Projector` with `NewProjector(opsReader *ops.Reader)`.
   - Implemented `Project(ctx)` projecting operations (`add`, `amend`, `supersede`, `retire`, `move`, `split`) into dossier state with deterministic sorting by type and entry ID.
   - Implemented `ProjectBefore(ctx, beforeCommit)` supporting time-cut projection.

4. **Markdown Renderer** ([`renderer.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/dossiers/renderer.go)):
   - Implemented `RenderDossier`: renders purpose, grouped sections in specified order, omitting empty sections, and deterministic metadata badges.
   - Implemented `RenderHistory`: renders retired and superseded entries.
   - Implemented `RenderAtlas`: renders sorted table of all dossiers.

5. **Storage Writer** ([`writer.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/dossiers/writer.go)):
   - Implemented `WriteDossier`, `WriteAtlas`, and `WriteAll` writing to `.memory/dossiers/<scope>.md`, `.memory/dossiers/<scope>.history.md` (only if non-empty), and `.memory/ATLAS.md`.

6. **Cap Linting** ([`lint.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/dossiers/lint.go)):
   - Implemented `LintDossier` validating token cap (~3k tokens / 12k bytes), maximum entry length (6 lines), and presence of the purpose section.

7. **Hand-Edit Detection** ([`handedit.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/dossiers/handedit.go)):
   - Implemented `DetectHandEdits`: parses markdown entry headers and metadata lines, producing `amend` and `add` ops for changed or added entries.

8. **Test Suite** ([`dossiers_test.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/dossiers/dossiers_test.go)):
   - Implemented test coverage for round-trip determinism, op projection (`add`, `amend`, `supersede`, `retire`, `move`, `split`), renderer formatting, history rendering and file output conditions, atlas sorting, cap linting, empty section omission, hand-edit detection, and `ProjectBefore` git commit time-cuts.

- `go vet ./internal/core/dossiers/...` passes with zero issues.
- Round-trip property verified (ops → project → render → re-render → write → read).
